name: briefing_action_queue_add_set_widget_image_timed
description: Briefing_ActionQueue::AddSetWidgetImageTimed allocates a timed image action, stores the image and widget, hides the widget, initializes the timer, inserts the action, and returns the updated node count.
known_limits: Focused VC5 COFF byte comparison is clean in briefing_action_queue_add_methods; owner tier S remains deferred to the complete Briefing source-owner because tick bodies and the runtime constructor remain byte-blocked.
functional_evidence: Binary Ninja decompilation for 0x4048a0 validates EH-framed allocation of a 16-byte timed-image action, image/widget storage, immediate widget SetVisible(0), timer initialization to 1.0, queue-node insertion, node-count increment, and return of the updated count.
The native briefing objective-action smoke verifies objective-picture image actions, image references, widget target, timer initialization, and immediate hide dispatch.
